capfood.list.title: CONFIGURABLE FOODS
capfood.food.description: Applies the same nutritional values as Cooked Beef.
capfood.food.cooked_cod.lore: Caught in cold waters and carried to the fire, cod keeps the strength needed for any journey within its taste of the waves.
capfood.food.cooked_porkchop.lore: Golden over the fire and hearty as a feast, porkchop rewards adventurers with the warm comfort of a truly generous meal.
capfood.food.cooked_mutton.lore: Slowly roasted, mutton turns days in open fields into a robust meal capable of warming journeys beneath the falling snow.
capfood.food.cooked_rabbit.lore: Small and rare, cooked rabbit offers a delicate flavor that rewards patient hunters after long trails across the countryside.
capfood.food.cooked_chicken.lore: Simple, golden, and known in every village, cooked chicken restores strength with the welcoming taste of a warm kitchen.
capfood.food.cooked_salmon.lore: Born in rushing rivers, salmon keeps after the fire all the energy of the currents it conquered to travel so very far away.
capfood.food.mushroom_stew.lore: Mushrooms from shadowed corners meet within the bowl, making a warm broth that carries the forest's silence in every spoonful.
capfood.food.rabbit_stew.lore: Roots, mushrooms, and meat meet in a careful stew, proving that patience can transform humble ingredients into true nourishment.
capfood.food.suspicious_stew.lore: Mysterious flowers season this broth; every spoonful sustains the body while an uncertain fate awakens quietly within.
capfood.food.beetroot_soup.lore: Red as sunset over the fields, beetroot soup warms the hands and returns the enduring vigor of the earth to weary travelers.
capfood.food.baked_potato.lore: Beneath its toasted skin, the potato keeps the fire's warmth and the fields' simplicity, a faithful companion on distant journeys.
capfood.food.cookie.lore: Small in the pocket yet rich in sweetness, a cookie carries cocoa from distant lands to turn any brief pause into celebration.
capfood.food.cake.lore: Layers of wheat, milk, and sugar turn a table into a gathering place, because no great adventure should ever go without a party.
capfood.food.honey_bottle.lore: The light of flowers and labor of countless bees rest inside the bottle, offering travelers a golden sip of gentle springtime.
capfood.food.apple.lore: Gathered among oak leaves, an apple carries the forest's simplicity and the crisp promise of strength renewed for the road.
capfood.food.bread.lore: Patiently cultivated wheat becomes bread, the food that crosses villages and keeps adventurers steady upon every distant road.
capfood.food.pumpkin_pie.lore: Pumpkin, sugar, and egg meet in a fragrant slice, bringing the warmth of harvest season to journeys far beyond the fields.
capfood.food.glow_berries.lore: Born in the darkness of caves, glow berries preserve an underground spark to nourish those who keep traveling without sunlight.
capfood.action.toggle_all.tooltip: Toggle between selecting and deselecting all.
capfood.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
capfood.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
capfood.options.consume_container.lore: An adventurer's hunger knows no waste: bowls and bottles also disappear completely when the final bite of a meal is finished.
capfood.options.consume_container.descri: Also consumes stew bowls, honey bottles and drinkable potion bottles.
capfood.options.show_food_properties.lor: Trained eyes recognize every food's value before the first bite, measuring nourishment, vigor, and time with a single glance.
capfood.options.show_food_properties.des: Shows hunger, saturation and consumption time while holding Shift over a compatible food or the reference Cooked Beef. For Suspicious Stew, it lists every possible effect without revealing which effect the item contains.
Some secrets await a closer look; a small mark reveals which items still conceal valuable knowledge beneath their surface.
Adds an asterisk to the end of the name of every item with information shown only while holding Shift, including content from Minecraft and other mods.
capfood.options.prevent_rotten_flesh_wol: Wolves trust the hand that feeds them without hesitation; adventurers must keep that loyalty from accepting a corrupted meal.
Prevents feeding wolves with Rotten Flesh.
capfood.options.prevent_primary_food_con: Humble ingredients promise more than a hurried meal, patiently awaiting fire, a cooking pot, and the touch of creative hands.
Prevents consuming these 12 primary foods: Beetroot, Carrot, Potato, Raw Beef, Raw Chicken, Raw Mutton, Raw Porkchop, Raw Rabbit, Pufferfish, Raw Cod, Raw Salmon and Tropical Fish.
capfood.options.horse_ignores_leaves.lor: Brave mounts no longer recoil before the canopy; horse and rider pass through foliage like a swift wind among the branches.
capfood.options.horse_ignores_leaves.des: Removes leaf collision for horse-family mounts while controlled by a player.
capfood.options.faster_leaf_decay.lore: Without the trunk that held them high, leaves quickly answer the ground's call and return open space for the forest to grow anew.
capfood.options.faster_leaf_decay.descri: After cutting the last connected log of a natural Overworld tree, assigned leaves disappear 20× faster than vanilla. Touching canopies estimate leaf origin by log proximity. Remaining leaves disappear together after 5 seconds.
capfood.options.increased_sapling_bee_ne: Where a flower accompanies a young tree, bees glimpse a future home and arrive early to establish their tiny new colony.

Increases from 5% to 20% the chance for oak, birch and cherry trees grown from saplings to generate with a bee nest containing 2–3 bees when a flower is within 2 blocks horizontally and 1 block vertically of the sapling.
capfood.options.bees_survive_stinging.lo: Defending its hive, a bee gives all its courage but not its life; its gentle flight continues long after using the stinger.
capfood.options.bees_survive_stinging.de: Prevents bees from dying after stinging. The sting retains its vanilla damage and poison.
capfood.options.show_status_effect_panel: Magic and maladies leave clear signs upon adventurers; every effect takes its place, visible while it still shapes their fate.

Shows a panel in the HUD's top-right corner with the icon, name, level and remaining duration of each active effect, following the inventory panel's appearance and ordering. Names wider than Night Vision are abbreviated. Hides the inventory effect panel.
capfood.options.show_potion_recipes.lore: Among bottles and secrets, an attentive alchemist recognizes every path an Awkward Potion can open upon the brewing stand.
capfood.options.show_potion_recipes.desc: While holding Shift, shows the compatible ingredients for each potion brewed directly from an Awkward Potion: its brewing ingredient, Redstone for extended duration, Gunpowder for the splash form and Glowstone Dust for potency, when available.
capfood.status.applied: CAP applied to the selected foods.
